response.sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT account_id, type, amount, balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE amount >= 2400
),
signed AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN CAST(amount AS REAL)
                  WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -CAST(amount AS REAL) END) AS avg_signed_amount
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ')
  GROUP BY account_id
),
bal AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(CAST(balance AS REAL)) AS avg_balance
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) FROM signed) AS avg_signed_amount,
  (SELECT AVG(avg_balance) FROM bal) AS avg_balance;

assumptions.assumption: The amount filter applies to the transaction set for both figures. The balance average uses every qualifying transaction regardless of type, including VYBER rows, which the request does not exclude from that figure.

Per-account signed average is the mean of signed amounts over that account's PRIJEM and VYDAJ rows with amount >= 2400. Other types, including VYBER, are excluded from the signed figure as the request specifies. Accounts with no such rows are dropped from the first average only.
The across-account average is an unweighted mean of per-account averages. Amounts are cast to REAL so no integer division occurs, and the result is not rounded.
